name: Nann crisps
ingredients_raw: Enriched wheat flour, Sunflower and/or canola oil, Sugar, Corn starch, Dehydrated onion, Sesame seeds, Sea salt, Poppy seeds, Black sesame seeds, Yeast, Ghee (clarified butter), Garlic blend (dehydrated garlic, sunflower oil), Buttermilk (milk ingredients, bacterial culture), Baking soda, Natural flavour, Monocalcium phosphate. Contains: Wheat, Milk, Barley, Sesame seeds.
